title: UNSU Wallet
tagline: Use crypto as the easiest and simplest way to send and receive value.
description: Using crypto should be much easier than it is now, and it feels like in the last few years it just got harder with too many options, checks, and waiting for approvals. By focusing on simplicity and a user-centric design, we aim to transform the crypto experience, making it as straightforward as using a simple webpage.
how_its_made:
The main challenge of this project was to deliver something end-to-end that can be used and experienced by anyone by simply using a web-browser. This was deployed and is live at https://unsu.com

We tried to used the least amount of technologies and simply our stack to the minimal possible dependencies to achieve the objective of a minimalist web-wallet that requires no email/login/accounts/etc, and can be used/accessed from virtually any device, any where, any time.

For this we used HTML, CSS, Vanilla JavaScript, Python, Flask, ENS libraries, and Ethers v5.
